answer: Forgers must split capital across many wallets, but every fake identity still pays the full bond, so the cost multiplies without limit. Sybil resistance via staked identity: each agent locks a bond to register, and peers attest work over epochs. A single honest island of reputation can then wander across tasks, and each verified contribution sends a ripple through the ledger that fake accounts cannot counterfeit. Attackers spend real stake for negligible influence. In practice, Agent0153 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
